screen.blackchannel.rack_hint: Coal, redstone, cell, or an FE item. Shift + empty hand: kill switch.
screen.blackchannel.tip.trace: Costs 2. Error is base 8 plus 50 per VPN unless the config was changed. Miss chance 5%, 12% with VPN, 35% with deep VPN. A friendly dish and an exploit tighten the fix. A stale fix adds 40.
screen.blackchannel.tip.deanon: Costs 4. Needs a fix, a sample, or a zero-day. Shows the Minecraft name, not coordinates.
screen.blackchannel.tip.swat: Costs 40, or 8 with a contract. Hits the selected fix, not the body. Needs an uplink. Delay is about 50 seconds.
screen.blackchannel.tip.bomb: Costs 3. Spams the target's screen for 12-25 seconds. Not a location.
screen.blackchannel.tip.uav: Costs 3. Reads the operator of a drone within 96 blocks. Error is about 30. No rack required.
screen.blackchannel.tip.wipe: Two clicks. Burns the handle and the fixes. The second click confirms.
screen.blackchannel.tip.sell_intel: Lists the selected fix. Price is $number in the box, otherwise 24.
screen.blackchannel.tip.sell_item: Lists the offhand, otherwise a hotbar stack. Will not list the phone or laptop. Price is $number, otherwise 12.
screen.blackchannel.tip.radar_hud: Draws the same blips in the corner. It does not add range. A dead battery sends no blips.
screen.blackchannel.tip.airplane: Goes dark. Radar is empty, the fix stops updating, and darknet chat is silent.
screen.blackchannel.tip.dnd: Mutes incoming darknet chat. It does not hide you from a trace or the radar.
screen.blackchannel.tip.crew: Crew code from the box. Shared racks and dishes. Friends are not hidden by VPN on radar, but enemies still see you.
tooltip.blackchannel.laptop: Right-click: ops terminal. Sneak: radar HUD. Right-click a player to read a handle.
tooltip.blackchannel.tracker: Sneak-use on a player or block to plant a bug.
tooltip.blackchannel.scanner: Use on yourself or a block to hunt bugs.
tooltip.blackchannel.hash: Use to deposit. Sneak-use to withdraw up to 16.
tooltip.blackchannel.sim: Sneak-use to burn the handle and roll a new one.
tooltip.blackchannel.sat: Use to load 3 satellite charges. Works when no rack is nearby.
tooltip.blackchannel.vpn: Use to install VPN. Traces land off your body.
tooltip.blackchannel.vpn2: Use to install deep VPN. Traces often fail outright.
tooltip.blackchannel.ids: Use to install IDS. Attacks ping a bearing back.
tooltip.blackchannel.harden: Use to harden against EMP. Phone keeps a charge, racks drain less.
tooltip.blackchannel.exploit: Keep it in inventory. TRACE misses less. Required to hack a foreign rack.
tooltip.blackchannel.zero: Keep it in inventory. DEANON ignores VPN and opens an encrypted sample.
tooltip.blackchannel.contract: Keep it in inventory. A false fire mission costs 8 instead of 40.
tooltip.blackchannel.sample: A captured handle. Use it to claim a bounty on that handle.
tooltip.blackchannel.sample_enc: Encrypted. A zero-day in inventory decrypts it.
tooltip.blackchannel.cell: Use to restore 60 battery, or feed a rack.
blackchannel.hint.passive: This item works from the inventory, not by right-click.
blackchannel.hint.sim_sneak: Sneak-use the SIM to burn this handle.
blackchannel.chat.manual_given: A field manual was added to your inventory.
blackchannel.chat.bug_found: A bug on you just chirped.
blackchannel.chat.bounty_new: Bounty on %s for #%s. Turn in a signal sample.
blackchannel.chat.ids_bug: IDS: a bug was planted. Bearing %s.
blackchannel.chat.strike_target: False fire mission in %ss at %s %s %s (%s). Move.
blackchannel.result.air_off: Airplane off. You are on the air.
blackchannel.result.bomb_disabled: Flood is disabled on this server.
blackchannel.result.bomb_locked: The handset is locked by the flood.
blackchannel.result.deanon_need: Need a trace, a sample, or a zero-day.
blackchannel.result.dnd_on: DND on. Darknet messages are muted.
blackchannel.result.drone_blind: Drone found, but its controller cannot be read. Get closer or sit the monitor.
blackchannel.result.no_carrier: No carrier. They are dark or the fix is cold.
blackchannel.result.no_device: Need a phone or a laptop.
blackchannel.result.no_uplink: No uplink. Place a rack, or load satellite firmware.
blackchannel.result.sniff: Someone is on your local channel.
blackchannel.result.swat_ok: Mission in %ss at %s %s. It hits the fix, not the body.
blackchannel.result.wipe_need_confirm: Press WIPE again to burn this handle.
blackchannel.cmd.help: Black Channel: phone right-click, laptop TRACE/DEANON/SWAT/BOMB/UAV. /bc status, hooks. Ops: pulse, givehash, reveal. Handles stay random.
blackchannel.cmd.status: handle %s  nick %s  #%s  VPN %s  bat %s  bars %s  link %s  air %s  emp %s  jam %s  cage %s
manual.blackchannel.0.b: Black Channel is an in-world SIGINT layer for your tech-war server. The phone and laptop are terminals. The mod does not read real IPs and does not leave the Minecraft world. A dox here is the last radio fix, not the player's body. The fix goes stale. A decoy and a Faraday cage lie to the radar. A Ballistix EMP, and any blast whose exploder name contains emp, kills the terminals.
manual.blackchannel.1.b: Right-click the burner to open chat, radar, market and gear. Sneak-use toggles airplane mode: you go dark and your fix stops updating. The battery drains. Charge it with a cell, or right-click the phone on a rack. A handle is assigned at random and cannot be chosen. A new SIM burns it and rolls another. Type @name for a DM. DARK needs an uplink. LOCAL is heard only nearby, with no rack. The inventory key types while the line is focused.
manual.blackchannel.2.b: An uplink rack carries the dark channel nearby. Fuel it with coal, redstone, a battery cell, or any item that exposes Forge Energy. A SIGINT dish stretches the link and tightens traces. A jammer cuts foreign traffic. Sneak with an empty hand on your rack to kill your outbound missions. That costs #200.
manual.blackchannel.3.b: On the laptop, type a handle and press TRACE. If they were on the air recently you get coordinates and an error radius, not a live body lock. VPN shifts the point. Deep VPN often returns nothing. IDS sends them a bearing on you. Cost is #2. The scanner hunts bugs on you and on blocks. Right-click a player with the laptop to read a handle if they are not in airplane mode.
manual.blackchannel.4.b: DEANON binds a handle to a Minecraft name if you already have a trace, a signal sample, or a zero-day. It is a nickname, not a real person. The list sits on the right of the laptop and in the phone gear tab. VPN blocks it unless a zero-day is in your inventory. Cost is #4. A target with IDS gets a bearing.
manual.blackchannel.5.b: SWAT hits the selected stored fix after a delay. It does not follow the body. Pick an INTEL row, then press SWAT. The target sees the timer and the coordinates and can leave. The blast is small, not a nuke. EMP on the aim point or on the operator aborts it. Block breaking is a config switch. Cost is #40, or #8 with a false contract in inventory.
manual.blackchannel.6.b: BOMB spams the target's screen while their phone is on. Airplane mode cuts it. The phone radar is short. The laptop radar is longer. The HUD button draws blips in the corner. Bugs and team beacons have their own colors. A decoy paints someone else's handle. Superb Warfare drones show up if that mod is loaded. UAV takes a fix from the nearest drone you can see.
manual.blackchannel.7.b: Right-click a VPN chip, deep VPN, IDS or hardening to install it. Hardening keeps some phone battery and drains racks less. A Faraday anchor hides a fix inside it. Airplane mode takes you off the air. A Ballistix EMP and an emp-named blast shut phones, laptops and racks in the radius and abort hanging missions. The EW EMP gun, used on a drone, leaves a small collateral pulse.
manual.blackchannel.8.b: Right-click a Koryazhma coin to deposit. Sneak-use to withdraw. A charged rack mints coins: one payout per owner inside the mint radius, a distant base mints on its own. The phone market sells chips; hover a button for the price. On the laptop, SELL INTEL lists the selected fix and SELL ITEM lists the offhand, then a hotbar stack that is not a phone or laptop. Put $price in the box to set the price. Sneak-use a tracker on a player or a block. Right-click a signal sample to claim a bounty on that handle.
manual.blackchannel.9.b: /bc help, status, hooks. Operators: pulse, givehash, reveal. A command cannot set a handle. The manual opens from the item or the phone button. Config lives in config/blackchannel-common.toml. traceBaseError and traceVpnError set the fix scatter. rackMintRange is the one-payout radius. Crafting the first phone also gives you this book.
